question: How well do signals visible at 14:45-15:10 IST predict the next NIFTY gap?
method:
gap_predict_study.py - "the money is in the GAP - we must anticipate the day before" (desk order 21 Nov 2026 11:40). Pure code, no AI calls, research only.
QUESTION  How well do signals visible at ~14:30-15:10 IST on India day D predict the NEXT India session's gap (open D+1 vs close D), its sign / size,
          and the D+1 close? Only information up to 15:10 IST on D is used for signals (target uses the 15:30 close of D as its base, as the gap does).
DATA      Yahoo chart API (raw in /home/globalbot/girdata/ext/gap_predict_study/raw/, read as data only):
            60m bars (Yahoo keeps ~730 days: futures from Jul 2024) for NQ=F, ES=F, SOX=F, YM=F, NIY=F, ^GDAXI, ^FTSE, ^STOXX50E, ZN=F, DX-Y.NYB,
            CL=F, BZ=F, GC=F, INR=X; 5m bars (~60 days) for the same list; daily bars for Asia (^N225 ^KS11 ^TWII ^HSI), ^GSPC / ^IXIC (US calendar
            and US-night move), ^NSEI ^NSEBANK ^CNXIT (long Asia-only check, 2011 ->).
          India targets: Kite day candles history/ix_*.npz (exchange data, Nov 2021 -> 20 Nov 2026); NIFTY / BANKNIFTY minutes (hist_fresh, Nov 2023 ->
          19 Nov 2026; girdata/minute for 20 Nov) for NIFTY at 14:30 / 15:10 and a first-minute gap check.
TIMING    60m bars start on the UTC hour, so the latest 60m value before 15:10 IST is the close of the bar ending 09:00 UTC = 14:30 IST. All "14:30"
          values = that bar close. Futures / FX / commodities are measured from the previous US cash close (16:00 New York on the last US session
          before D) to 14:30 IST. Europe (DAX / FTSE / STOXX) from its previous close to 14:30 IST (= its first hour in winter, first two in summer).
          Asia = its own close on D vs its previous close (all four close by 13:40 IST). NIFTY at 14:30 / 15:10 = minute closes vs its previous close.
          5m bars give exact 14:45 IST values for the last ~60 days (used for the 20 Nov check and a 14:30-vs-14:45 comparison).
  python3 -I gap_predict_study.py fetch     -> download raw (market closed only)
  python3 -I gap_predict_study.py           -> report + json + lesson
